principles.title: Hair on Fire Problem
principles.description: Focus on problems that are urgent and painful enough that users are already seeking or hacking together solutions.

principles.title: Avoid 'Nice-to-Haves'
principles.description: Startups failing to find market fit often solve problems that are mild inconveniences rather than critical blockers.

principles.title: Get Out of the Building
principles.description: Iterate based on raw conversation data from at least 30-50 potential users before finalizing your MVP spec.

principles.title: Validate via Behavior, Not Words
principles.description: Don't ask 'would you use this?'. Ask 'how do you currently solve this?' and look for existing spend.

principles.title: The $5k Constraint
principles.description: Force innovation through scarcity. If an MVP cannot be built for $5k, the scope is likely too broad for a first iteration.

principles.title: Time-to-Feedback
principles.description: Minimize the gap between code commit and user feedback. Speed is the only advantage for a startup.
